title: BiometricSample
description: One HealthKit sample as it crosses the biometric_barrier into the Modulation Layer. NEVER enters the trace or reflex pipelines — Rule 9 + ADR-0001.

type.description: HealthKit type identifier, normalized to snake_case.

value.description: Sample value in the unit declared below.

unit.description: Unit string as returned by HKQuantitySample (e.g., 'count/min', 'ms', 'kcal').

sampled_at.description: Wall-clock timestamp on the source device. Used for the freshness window check in AllostasisTracker.

ingested_at.description: Timestamp at which the XPC bridge delivered the sample to the Harlo daemon. Optional; defaults to receive time.

bundle_id.description: HKSource.bundleIdentifier — used for provenance, never for identification.

confidence.description: Optional confidence hint from the source (e.g., on-wrist detection).
